items.name: base
items.title: Rime base: tokens and base styles
items.description: Design tokens (Default and Flat presets, light and dark modes), base element rules, the shadcn variable bridge and the shared internals. Install first.
items.docs: Import the styles in app/globals.css, before anything else: @import "./styles/tokens.css"; @import "./styles/base.css"; @import "./styles/shadcn-bridge.css"; Add your theme.css (from Rime Studio) after them. Requires the "@/*": ["./*"] path alias and no src/ directory.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Stacked sections that open and close in place: one at a time or several, on glass or plain hairlines.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: An inline message in a tone (info, success, warning, danger) or a quiet legal box for fixed wording, with an action and dismiss.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: AlertDialog
items.description: A short interrupting confirm with Cancel and one action; focus starts on Cancel and the scrim never dismisses it.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: AspectRatio
items.description: A box held to a width-to-height ratio, so media keeps its shape and never shifts the layout while loading.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Initials on the brand gradient or a neutral disc, in three sizes.

items.name: badge
items.title: StatusPill, Badge and CountBadge
items.description: Status pills (tinted fill, tinted edge, deep ink), small uppercase tags, and count badges.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Where this page sits: a trail of links ending on the current page, folding its middle into a menu when long.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: The action control: primary gradient, glass secondary, ghost, and two danger forms, in three sizes.

items.name: button-group
items.title: ButtonGroup
items.description: Joins Buttons and IconButtons into one segmented row or column with shared outer corners.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A solid card with a washed header, a lifted highlight tone, and a sunken muted tone.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A row of slides on a native scroll-snap track, with frosted prev and next buttons, dots and arrow keys.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A native checkbox drawn as a gradient tick, plain or as a selectable card, with indeterminate.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: One disclosure: a title row with a toggle, an always-visible summary and a region that opens beneath it.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A text field that filters a list of options as you type and picks one, with optional create.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A command palette: a search box over grouped actions with shortcuts, keyboard-first, inline or as a Ctrl+K dialog.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: ContextMenu
items.description: A menu of actions for a region, opened at the pointer with a right-click, Shift+F10 or a long press.

items.name: danger-zone
items.title: TypeToConfirmModal and DangerZone
items.description: The heaviest confirm: an impact preview and a typed phrase; and the Danger zone section that leads to it.

items.name: date-field
items.title: DateField
items.description: A typed DD/MM/YYYY field with a calendar popover, min/max and a date-of-birth preset.

items.name: date-range-filter
items.title: DateRangeFilter
items.description: A date-range chip for filter rows: presets plus a two-month range calendar.

items.name: divider
items.title: Divider
items.description: A hairline rule, horizontal or vertical, optionally labelled, with spacing steps.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: EmptyState
items.description: What an empty list means and what to do next: default, positive (all done) and filtered tones.

items.name: error-summary
items.title: ErrorSummary
items.description: The list of form errors at the top of a form, focused on submit, each linking to its field.

items.name: field
items.title: TextInput
items.description: The text field: a white box with a tinted edge, a brand halo on focus, adornments and a password reveal.

items.name: file-drop
items.title: FileDrop
items.description: A drop zone and file picker with type and size checks and per-file status chips.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: FilterBar
items.description: The one filter row above every table: a growing search, dropdown chips at the end, clear, and the list's own action.

items.name: filter-chip
items.title: FilterBar
items.description: The one filter row above every table: a growing search, dropdown chips at the end, clear, and the list's own action.

items.name: glass-panel
items.title: GlassPanel
items.description: Frosted glass over the page field: page, light and nested variants, padding steps and an optional bloom.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: HoverCard
items.description: A rich preview on hover or keyboard focus of a link: a person, a project, a record.

items.name: icon
items.title: icon
items.description: Rime icon.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: IconButton
items.description: A square action with only an icon, a required accessible label and a tooltip-friendly hit area.

items.name: impact-preview
items.title: ImpactPreview
items.description: What a destructive action will change, row by row, before it is confirmed.

items.name: input-group
items.title: InputGroup
items.description: A text field with addons joined to it: a fixed text segment, an icon, or a button such as Copy.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd and KbdGroup
items.description: Keyboard keys as small raised key caps, alone or as a combination.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: A standalone form label with required and optional markers, for controls outside a Field.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: An action menu from a button: groups, headings, separators, icons, links and danger items, in a frosted popover.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A desktop application menu bar (File, Edit, View) with keyboard navigation across and within its menus.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter and ProgressBar
items.description: A segmented meter for small counts (seats used) and a bar for progress through a total.

items.name: modal
items.title: Modal
items.description: A frosted dialog with a focus trap, scroll lock, inert page, scroll-aware edges and a bottom sheet on phones.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: NavigationMenu
items.description: Top-level site navigation with frosted dropdown panels of described links, built as disclosure navigation.

items.name: nav-search
items.title: NavSearch and SmartSearch
items.description: Top-bar search: NavSearch jumps to pages and actions; SmartSearch queries records with grouped results.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OtpInput
items.description: A six-cell one-time code entry with paste, auto-advance and onComplete.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: An anchored frosted panel for arbitrary content: a short form, a set of options, a details block.

items.name: prefixed-input
items.title: PrefixedInput
items.description: A fixed-format code with a set prefix: an invoice number, an account code, a membership number.

items.name: progress-steps
items.title: ProgressSteps
items.description: A horizontal track of steps with detail and meta lines, or a compact dot track for table cells.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: RadioGroup
items.description: One choice from a few: a list, inline, or cards in 1 to 3 columns.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Panels split by draggable hairline handles, side by side or stacked, with keyboard resizing and minimum sizes.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Modal
items.description: A frosted dialog with a focus trap, scroll lock, inert page, scroll-aware edges and a bottom sheet on phones.

items.name: search-field
items.title: SearchField
items.description: Field-size search on the grey frosted recess: clear button, loading state and an optional key hint.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A custom listbox: a recessed field or filter chip that opens a frosted popover, optionally searchable.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet and Drawer
items.description: A panel that slides in from an edge over a scrim, and a bottom Drawer with a drag handle.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Loading placeholders shaped like the content they stand in for, with a soft shimmer.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Picks a number or a range by dragging along a track, with steps, marks and a value readout.

items.name: smart-search
items.title: NavSearch and SmartSearch
items.description: Top-bar search: NavSearch jumps to pages and actions; SmartSearch queries records with grouped results.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A small brand-tinted spinner for in-flight work inside buttons, fields and panels.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: The wizard's step list: lettered markers, states, and optional navigation back to finished steps.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on/off setting that takes effect immediately, with a loading state while it saves.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: The one table look: neutral header row, whole-cell sortable headers, skeleton, empty and error states, and Pagination.

items.name: tabs
items.title: FolderTabs and SegmentedControl
items.description: Folder tabs that sit on a glass panel with always-visible counts, and a segmented control for views.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multi-line text in the TextInput box, resizable vertically, with an optional character count.

items.name: text-input
items.title: TextInput
items.description: The text field: a white box with a tinted edge, a brand halo on focus, adornments and a password reveal.

items.name: time-field
items.title: TimeField and TimeRangeField
items.description: A time of day with typed input and a popup picker; the range variant pairs start and end on one row.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Frosted toasts for success, error, info and in-flight work, stacked as a deck that fans out on hover.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A two-state button, pressed or not, for toolbar formatting and view options.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip and Toggletip
items.description: Hover and focus tooltips (dark one-liners or light rich cards) and click-to-open toggletips for help.

items.name: type-to-confirm
items.title: TypeToConfirmModal and DangerZone
items.description: The heaviest confirm: an impact preview and a typed phrase; and the Danger zone section that leads to it.

items.name: sidebar-shell
items.title: SidebarShell
items.description: The signed-in frame in four layouts: an expanded frosted sidebar, a collapsible icon rail, a header-only top nav, and a drawer on narrow screens.

items.name: page-header
items.title: PageHeader
items.description: A page's h1 with a back link, a meta line, a description and actions.

items.name: auth-card
items.title: AuthCard and AuthLayout
items.description: The sign-in card: a solid card on a deep field, with a logo slot, icon tile, title, footer strip and back link.

items.name: charts
items.title: Chart
items.description: Themed charts on Recharts: line, area, bar and donut in one frame with a table view, plus sparklines and a stat strip.

meta.import: import { LineChart, AreaChart, BarChart, DonutChart } from "@/components/charts";

items.name: sample-data
items.title: sample-data
items.description: Rime sample-data.

items.name: dashboard
items.title: Dashboard
items.description: The frosted shell, a page header, headline figures in one strip, an orders chart with a 7, 30 and 90 day switch, and the list-page table.
items.docs: Open /dashboard to see it. The page is app/dashboard/page.tsx; gate access inside it if the screen needs a signed-in user.

items.name: inbox
items.title: Inbox
items.description: A mail-style app in three resizable panes: folders, the message list with search and an unread switch, and the open message with a reply box.
items.docs: Open /inbox to see it. The page is app/inbox/page.tsx; gate access inside it if the screen needs a signed-in user.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table (tasks)
items.description: Tasks with one full-width search, status and priority dropdowns, row selection with select-all, a bulk actions bar and centred pagination.
items.docs: Open /tasks to see it. The page is app/tasks/page.tsx; gate access inside it if the screen needs a signed-in user.

items.name: settings
items.title: Settings
items.description: A section nav, field groups in one frosted panel, notification switches and a Danger zone whose actions confirm with a typed phrase.
items.docs: Open /settings to see it. The page is app/settings/page.tsx; gate access inside it if the screen needs a signed-in user.

items.name: sidebar-icon
items.title: Sidebar: collapsible icon rail
items.description: The sidebar folds to an icon rail from the top bar, and the choice is remembered.
items.docs: Open /projects to see it. The page is app/projects/page.tsx; gate access inside it if the screen needs a signed-in user.

items.name: sidebar-inset
items.title: Sidebar: inset
items.description: The page set into one frosted sheet inside the main area, with a secondary nav across its top.
items.docs: Open /projects to see it. The page is app/projects/page.tsx; gate access inside it if the screen needs a signed-in user.

items.name: header-only
items.title: Header only
items.description: No sidebar: logo, a short nav and the profile in one frosted top bar, the page full width below.
items.docs: Open /projects to see it. The page is app/projects/page.tsx; gate access inside it if the screen needs a signed-in user.

items.name: auth-login
items.title: Sign in with MFA
items.description: Password, then the authenticator code, with authenticator setup when a device is lost. Brand bar above, security note below.
items.docs: Open /login to see it. The page is app/login/page.tsx; gate access inside it if the screen needs a signed-in user.

items.name: auth-signup
items.title: Create an account
items.description: Name, work email, a password and the terms, in one card.
items.docs: Open /signup to see it. The page is app/signup/page.tsx; gate access inside it if the screen needs a signed-in user.

items.name: auth-otp
items.title: Email code
items.description: A six-digit code sent by email, with resend.
items.docs: Open /verify to see it. The page is app/verify/page.tsx; gate access inside it if the screen needs a signed-in user.

items.name: auth-mfa-setup
items.title: Set up an authenticator
items.description: Scan a QR code or type the key, then confirm with the first code.
items.docs: Open /security/mfa to see it. The page is app/security/mfa/page.tsx; gate access inside it if the screen needs a signed-in user.

items.name: auth-reset
items.title: Reset password
items.description: Ask for the email and send a reset link.
items.docs: Open /reset-password to see it. The page is app/reset-password/page.tsx; gate access inside it if the screen needs a signed-in user.

items.name: auth-check-email
items.title: Check your email
items.description: After a magic link or reset: what to do next, with resend.
items.docs: Open /check-email to see it. The page is app/check-email/page.tsx; gate access inside it if the screen needs a signed-in user.

items.name: kit
items.title: Rime: everything
items.description: Base, every component, the shells, the charts and the barrel (import { Button } from "@/components/ui"). One command to bootstrap or re-sync a project.
items.docs: Then add your theme: export theme.css from Rime Studio into app/styles/theme.css and import it after the base styles.

items.name: starter
items.title: Rime starter: layout, globals and theme setup
items.description: Root layout with Inter, the no-flash preset and dark-mode script and ToastProvider; globals importing Rime's styles and an empty theme.css.
items.docs: Put Inter at app/fonts/inter-latin-100-900-normal.woff2 (from the Rime repo, or use next/font/google in app/fonts.ts). Then make your theme in Rime Studio (https://rime.mjsons.net/themes) and paste it into app/styles/theme.css.

items.name: tailwind-bridge
items.title: Tailwind bridge
items.description: Maps shadcn's Tailwind colour and radius utilities onto Rime's tokens, for projects that also use real shadcn components.
items.docs: Import it in your Tailwind CSS entry, after the Rime base styles: @import "./styles/tailwind-bridge.css";

items.name: agents
items.title: Rime agent docs
items.description: docs/ui (llms.txt, llms-full.txt), the Rime Claude Code skill and an AGENTS.md block, so agents in a project build with Rime.
items.docs: Add one line to your AGENTS.md: "UI: follow AGENTS.rime.md." Re-run after kit updates.
